Platform Capabilities

Everything you need to run your practice

From patient records to billing, inventory, and analytics - we've got it covered.

Dashboard & Analytics

Real-time metrics, appointment volume, revenue tracking, and operational insights.

Client & Patient Mgmt

Comprehensive profiles, multi-pet households, medical history, and advanced search.

Smart Scheduling

Drag-and-drop calendar, conflict detection, automated reminders, and recurring visits.

Clinical Records

SOAP templates, prescription management, digital attachments, and treatment plans.

Inventory Control

Stock tracking, low stock alerts, supplier management, and expiration monitoring.

Billing & Finance

Automated invoicing, estimates, payment processing, and financial reporting.

Vaccinations

Immunization tracking, due date reminders, protocol management, and compliance.

Communication Center

Email/SMS integration, templates, call logging, and automated workflows.

Boarding & Hospital

Unit management, reservations, check-in/out, and medical monitoring.

Time & Attendance

Staff clock-in/out, scheduling, overtime tracking, and payroll integration.

Admin & Security

Role-based access (RBAC), audit logging, backups, and clinic configuration.

Task Management

Staff task assignment, priority levels, due dates, and progress tracking.
